title: Tuki's map of Aotearoa, drawn in 1793
credit: Tuki Te Terenui Whare Pirau; Alexander Turnbull Library, MapColl-CHA-2/1/9-Acc.36440
altText: Historical manuscript map of New Zealand attributed to Tuki, published in 1798.
caption: Map of Aotearoa drawn by Tuki Te Terenui Whare Pirau in 1793 and published in 1798. The map records geographic and cultural knowledge, including places and routes in the northern North Island.
context: This is a surviving copy of a Māori manuscript map. It predates computer mapping and is included to illustrate knowledge represented geographically before modern surveying and GIS.
